chapter: Carnegie Hall and the touring years
title: Buying a house for his mother; three chauffeurs
summary: He bought his mother the house he now lives in and traveled with chauffeurs Herman the German, Wallace Sellers and Bute.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: This house I'm in right now, I bought it for my mother. We looked all over California. Had some fellow out there, lived across the street from where I did. He was real estate man so he took me to ride around to a lot of old places I didn't like. I say, "I don't put my mother in no place like this."

So I had a friend of mine...another friend called Wallace Sellers (?). He was travellin' with me, too. I had three chauffeurs. I had Herman the German, Wallace Sellers, another...another boy called Bute (?). They were just like to travel and havin' fun an' so they travel around with me all up and down the highway. All I do's get back in the back seat an' go to sleep an' they would take me anywhere I was s'posed to go. So we went an' played one-nighters all up and down the ...the highway.
